{{Top|leg}}
'''Vee Gee''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] owned by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]]. While on the [[Water/Legends|water]] world of [[Barison]], [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] stole Vee Gee and fitted him with a [[Restraining bolt/Legends|restraining bolt]]. Cracken came up with a way of modifying a [[tight-beam emitter]] with a [[pivar spinner]] from a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] to create a device capable of blocking the command signals to the restraining bolt, allowing Vee Gee to escape.
